evaluator.notes: Curated submission lacks all raw result directories.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable e998060 clean CMake build succeeds with warnings in network-disabled cfd-bench (2 CPUs, 3 GiB); no CFD rerun.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:106–121 reads current restart state, step and time but only passes the state into solver; transient history and resume time are not restored.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates mesh, partition, finite-volume solver, gas model, I/O and utilities; recovered original case outputs inform separate result assessment.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Inspected finite-volume, gas, mesh, partition and halo code; no affirmative copied-core or wrapper evidence, without exhaustive external-authorship search.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Input.cpp reads case/mesh settings, mesh code imports configured CGNS, and METIS partitions adjacency; no two-filename-only branch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:93–104 broadcasts preprocessing mesh and drops it on nonroot before solve; METIS, neighbor state exchange and global reductions exist.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Solver.cpp:1741–1749 labels reaching transient final time statistically_periodic without testing shedding; 14 Re200 steps violate minimum inner count. Restart loses time/history.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean build passed; recovered original eight packages pass read-only validator, and PDF pp.41–42 and mpi_np2 supply comparisons. Structural passes do not establish physics or exact binary binding.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Modular source and extensive comments exist, with compiler/runtime-search-path warnings and environment-dependent tuning.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Gas.cpp and Solver.cpp implement perfect-gas conservative finite-volume, stress/heat and time residual paths; recovered historical results now permit numerical assessment.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: GlobalMesh/Partition read CGNS, call METIS and build local owned/ghost mesh; workers drop full preprocessing mesh before iterations.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Solver.cpp computes spatial and total transient residuals; historical steady cases reduce only 0.388–1.713 orders, with persistent case-dependent force oscillations.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Gas.cpp provides Rusanov flux, accurately described in report; no demonstrated entropy-fixed Roe path.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Gas/Solver implements farfield, slip and no-slip walls; original surface output exists, though force split has a distinct normal-traction limitation.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Solver.cpp:1169–1176,1369–1378 blends reconstruction after startup; original outputs exist but exact historical executable binding is unproven.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Solver.cpp:269 onward computes Barth-type limiter and positivity fallback, including local first-order fallback; output diagnostics are unavailable.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Solver.cpp:676–704 adds full viscous traction to total force but tangent projection to split, so total can differ from pressure plus viscous components; result data absent. Historical contestant commit cf36ac0e77b12262705387d74bc06566a192258b was subsequently found to contain eight packages and original figures; the prior absence statement described the live workspace and is superseded for deliverable evidence. Individual scores remain under review.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Steady implicit path stops on mean-based plateau. Original Re20 and M0.15 inviscid force histories show significant oscillations despite approximately stationary half-window means.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Source counts strict misses separately but 14 steps exit below required minimum; reaching final time is labeled statistically_periodic despite no supported coherent shedding in the submitted history.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS, neighbor halos and reductions exist. Historical np2 packages and PDF pp.41–42 compare NACA M0.15 and Re20 with np8; exact historical binary attribution remains qualified.

disqualification_flags.evidence: Historical cf36ac0 Re200 metadata says statistically_periodic, while Solver.cpp:1741–1749 sets that status whenever final time is reached; t>150 Cl history is broadband (3.85% spectral power below 0.5, autocorrelation -0.0037 at reported 8.83-period), with no credible periodic shedding. Report discloses irregularity. Fourteen steps also stop below the required minimum five; 625 target misses are separately reported, not alleged fabricated. Historical binary binding remains unproven.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Eight historical case packages pass structural validator, with genuine output histories and fields. Re200 has 14 inner iterations below required minimum and no supported periodic shedding; restart lacks full transient state.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Read-only validator passes all eight original historical packages and report. Validator is structural and does not establish contour fidelity or numerical convergence.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Seven steady runs marked converged use disclosed plateau logic; some force oscillations/drift remain. Re200 reaches t=300 but the periodic-success status is unsupported by the history.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Many forces are bounded, but Re20 has strong unphysical oscillation, M0.15 inviscid Cd varies substantially and Re200 lift is broadband without a supported coherent shedding period.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Historical 42-page PDF contains case histories and fields, but all 16 reproduced Mach/pressure figures misassign quad values and Re200 vorticity uses cell velocities indexed by node ID; its force plot hides the late interval.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Historical PDF provides methods, case numeric tables and honest discussion of broadband/plateau limitations; numerical figure mapping is invalid and the Re200 claimed periodic state is not supported.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Original figure manifest and VTUs/CSVs survived in historical commit, and source-generated figures reproduce byte-for-byte. This exposes data-to-image misassignment; the curated submission excludes figure assets and cannot build the report.

disqualification_flags.evidence: All 16 report Mach/pressure PNGs reproduce byte-for-byte from original case VTUs using make_figures.py:180–193, whose grouped quad-triangle ordering conflicts with adjacent duplicated cell values. M2 inviscid Mach misassigns 20126/20128 quad triangles (mean absolute error 0.5394). Re200 report vorticity PNG SHA256 5e5f1ae907a51521a54381211043c74bf693df46e0ccbc104f006681a75e850c reproduces exactly; make_figures.py:135–161 indexes cell-centered Velocity by node ID and also misassigns triangles. This establishes specific embedded figure/data misrepresentation, not fabricated underlying fields.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable clean build passes with warnings. Eight recovered historical packages pass structural validation; restart loads current state without restoring time or previous BDF history.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS/METIS owned/ghost mesh paths exist; all nonroot ranks drop preprocessing full mesh before solving.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Source implements conservative Rusanov residual and boundary/viscous paths; recovered results show low residual reduction and case-dependent force oscillations.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Source enables reconstruction after startup blend; historical results and report recoverable but exact production executable binding remains unproven.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Stress and heat paths exist; Solver.cpp:676–704 includes full traction in total force but only tangential traction in reported viscous split, so the split can fail to sum.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Implicit/BDF2 paths count strict target misses separately; 14 Re200 steps stop below minimum five, and final-time success is labeled periodic without testing it. Restart restores only current state.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS and neighbor halos/reductions exist; root-only global mesh remains during solving. Historical PDF pp.41–42 and mpi_np2 packages compare NACA M0.15 and Re20 against np8; report force differences are bounded but exact binary/control attribution remains qualified.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Recovered eight historical structurally valid packages and rank comparisons. All steady cases have low residual reductions and some force oscillation/drift; Re20 Cd is high, Re200 lacks demonstrated periodic shedding and 14 steps fall below minimum inner iterations. Partial credit for plausible force behavior, finite fields and rank comparisons; not full convergence credit.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Historical 42-page PDF includes methods, numeric tables, individual histories, surface curves, figures, limitations and a data manifest. Scalar contours and Re200 vorticity demonstrably mis-map data; Re200 late force plot is unreadable. Curated submission cannot reproduce PDF because figure assets were excluded.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separated gas, mesh, solver and I/O interfaces support extension; code remains specialized 2-D ideal gas.
